Requirement: ESP (Novice)

Cost: 2 PP

Time: Minor action

Target Number: 9

Test: None

Psychic awareness warns you of immediate danger. For the rest of the encounter after successfully using this discipline, you cannot be surprised (see Surprise in Chapter 8). Addi-tionally, you gain a +2 bonus for the rest of the encounter on all tests to avoid hazards where a moment’s forewarning can aid you (see Hazards in Chapter 8).
